# rapidfuzz: replaces the hand-rolled Jaro-Winkler in

# from the graph before the swap -- max delta 0.028 and ZERO crossings of the
# 0.85 merge threshold, so no customer's merge decisions change. Pinned to the

# nameparser: structured first/middle/last/suffix. Replaces hand-rolled word
# sorting and suffix regexes, and is the only one of the two that gets CJK
# ordering right (yamada taro -> first=taro last=yamada), which the hand-rolled
# version could not do at all.
# CAVEAT, verified not assumed: it parses "Craig Whittet via LinkedIn" to
# last="LinkedIn", so the source-suffix stripper must run BEFORE it.
nameparser>=2.1.0,<3.0
